title: WHO Medical Product Alert N°5/2025: Substandard (contaminated) oral liquid medicines identified in India (diethylene glycol)

sources.label: WHO Medical Product Alert N°5/2025 (13 October 2025)
WHO alert PDF with the annex of affected batches

notes: CDSCO reported DEG contamination in these three oral liquid medicines to WHO on 8 October 2025, after clusters of child deaths in India. The Tamil Nadu Drugs Control Department declared COLDRIF batch SR-13 (Sresan Pharmaceutical) Not of Standard Quality / adulterated on 2 October 2025. Contamination values are as reported by CDSCO in the WHO annex.

rows.reason: Contaminated with diethylene glycol (DEG): 48.6% w/v, as reported by CDSCO
rows.reportedBy: CDSCO (reported to WHO); declared by Tamil Nadu Drugs Control on 2 Oct 2025
